templates.title: Enclosure Approach Cue
templates.goal: Develop a calm, voluntary enclosure approach cue routine suitable for snake.
templates.summary: Develop a calm, voluntary enclosure approach cue routine suitable for snake.

lessons.title: Introduce and reinforce
steps: Observe a calm baseline and select an appropriate positive outcome.
Reinforce small voluntary approximations toward the behavior.
Introduce a consistent cue after reliable success in a quiet environment.

safetyNotes: Use voluntary, reward-based methods; never punish or force the behavior.
Stop at signs of distress, avoidance, or fatigue.
Adapt all practice to the species and individual.
Prioritize low-stress husbandry and avoid unnecessary handling.

cover.altText: Corn snake rests within a spacious secure planted terrarium with bark hide and water dish; caregiver holds blank lavender cue card OUTSIDE glass and watches without tapping.
